authorizedBy: Repository owner explicit decision in this Codex task on 2026-07-20.
decision: Use the documented AI tabletop simulation as a scoped unblocker for building the full local-first MVP.
constraints: This exception does not convert AI simulation output into participant evidence, accessibility evidence, legal clearance, or a signed DesignOps direction or handoff approval.

Only the local-first Expo MVP under apps/mobile, plus the build-time content pipeline under tools/content-pipeline, is authorized; accounts, public UGC, live X integration, and multiplayer rooms remain excluded. Amended 2026-08-04 by owner decision: AI may draft decoy text where a named human editor rewrites, approves and owns the shipped line and decoyMethod records ai_assisted (ADR-012); unattributed model impersonation and any decoy that reaches the bundle without two distinct editorial approvals remain excluded. Amended 2026-08-09 by owner decision: the 'political breaking-news decks' exclusion is REMOVED, so political figures and their archived posts are in scope. This lifts a scope limit only. It changes nothing about the safety model: the banned-category lexicon still blocks election-falsehood, hate, crime, sexual and medical-financial-advice content; G11 still blocks a fabricated statement naming a third party; sensitivity containment, the two-person rule and the takedown SLA are unchanged. A political figure is now an eligible figure, not an exempt one.
Release remains fail-closed and still requires signed handoff and release approvals plus current iOS/Android native verification evidence.
Every pull request still requires repository enforcement, GitHub visibility, code review, and security review.
